meta.title: About
meta.description: Learn about the GDG on Campus DOU community, its teams, events, and the experiences it offers students.

title: About us
intro: We are a technology community at Doğuş University that brings together students interested in Google technologies, software development, and building together.

who.title: A student community that learns, shares, and builds together.
who.body: GDG on Campus DOU helps students improve their technical skills through workshops, technology talks, study groups, and project teams. Our goal is to build a lasting learning culture on campus and connect students with the technology ecosystem.

learning.title: Learning and sharing
learning.body: We create and share knowledge together through workshops, presentations, and peer learning.

community.title: Community and networking
community.body: Our events bring students, alumni, and industry professionals together in the same room.

projects.title: Project-focused teams
projects.body: We build throughout the semester with web, mobile, game, design, organization, and sponsorship teams.

work.title: From events to team projects, we offer a hands-on, build-focused experience.

items.events: We organize events focused on artificial intelligence, web, mobile, cloud, and careers.
items.teams: We work in organization, web, mobile, game, social media, and design teams.
items.resources: We share student-focused resources, opportunities, and building experiences with the community.

cta.title: Become part of the community
cta.body: Follow our events, meet the teams, and start building together at GDG on Campus DOU.
